g.text: Figure 3 | Five AppTest expressions in plain language
Tell the test tool which application to test.
Simulate entering SYN-001 in the selected input field.
Simulate pressing the button, then rerun the program.
Require a success message on the new screen.
Require no success message on the screen.
Each entry explains an operation or assertion. There are no arrows: the
entries are not a required execution sequence.
